name: agent-tool-safety
goal: Prove raw model proposals cannot reach guarded effects without current scoped grants, applicable content and budget checks, and exact human authorization.

evidence: Committed spec defines the model/host trust boundary, exact grants and approvals, durable reservations, content checks, journal metadata, and Harbor acceptance.
Harness SDK cce2be9407 brokers dispatch. Harbor worker c0d3401 adopts it with SQLite reservations and exact owner review. Harbor Desktop 1f21bb1 renders and decides the held action.

Harness stub suite passed five cases. Harbor worker test red 303be59 HTTP 404 and green c0d3401, 135 total. Desktop red 5b23fc5 missing review region and green 1f21bb1, three Electron cases on harbor-mbp-2 against worker 0cf2ec2.

title: Prove owner approval rejects changed outgoing content at execution.

evidence: On harbor-mbp-2, vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/services/agents-providers/agent-tool-safety.test.ts failed on the test-only checkpoint 6942956334 because approval executed changed resolved content. The unchanged test and all five cases passed with 35619814da. Harbor CLI 6b066c1 passed 135 tests with the Harness 35619814da SDK bundled, and all three one-worker Electron cases passed at Desktop 17d1218 with combined SQLite worker abb2ac9.

title: Pass the strict unit registry after rebasing

evidence: At 5f6eca3b20, the unchanged Counts contract findings per kind case failed with one bare Error and units check found two missing stable IDs. After UID backfill and documenting the broker failure as a returned decision, the unchanged case passed and units check reported zero stored or projected contract findings across 2088 units.
